QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_36

question.text: A ZCZP-funded Nari Shakti SHG programme closes after 3 years. Under SAS-400, the MOST critical SUSTAINABILITY question the SIA must address in the end-line assessment is:

answer.text: Whether the CEO is happy with the programme
Whether the SHGs will survive post-programme without continued SE funding
Whether the marketing material was glossy
Whether the donor received a thank-you letter

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Sustainability = whether the outcome persists after the intervention ends. For SHGs, this means SHG continued-operations rate, peer-savings retention, and federation/cluster linkage — not programme-side satisfaction metrics. **The Trap:** Options A, C, D are peripheral / PR considerations. **Cross-Exam Context:** Sustainability overlaps X-A / X-B (Investment Adviser — client-outcome durability) and XIX (AIF — wind-down planning). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Schedule the end-line for 3-6 months AFTER programme exit, not on the last day. That delay is when the true sustainability signal emerges.
